scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I’d like to check on the status of my loan application. It was for a VA refinance, amount $1,065,000, and I did not request preapproval. Has my application been approved, denied, or is it still under review?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for providing your application details. Your VA refinance loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you need information about your loan terms or any other details, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the update, that’s a relief to hear!

Could you please tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your approved VA refinance loan has an interest rate of 5.99%. The total costs associated with the loan are $10,587.26. If you need clarification on these figures or further details, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing those details. I have a couple more questions:

1. Are there any high-cost (HOEPA) flags or negative amortization features on my loan?
2. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution, or is it still with your company?
dialogue.agent:
1. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not include any negative amortization features.
2. After origination, your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for answering my questions so clearly. That gives me peace of mind, and I appreciate you checking on whether my loan included any high-cost features or negative amortization, as well as letting me know about the transfer to Ginnie Mae.

Overall, the information was provided promptly, with clear explanations and a professional tone.

<Very Satisfied>

I’m very satisfied with the service—I felt listened to, got all my questions answered, and now understand my situation clearly. Thanks again!
